purpose: Reviewed identity-resolution dispositions for curated State Schedule-freeze actor/project references that do not resolve safely by canonical name alone.

non_inference: binding a registry reference to an identity is not a Claim of participation, operation, control or culpability
deferred means the representation boundary is not exact enough; it is not an evidence or governance judgment
multi-identity bindings do not imply hierarchy or relations between the bound identities
partial-deferred preserves the exact resolved component while keeping unspecified components unresolved
semantics.review_binding: Every source containing reviewed dispositions is pinned to its exact Git blob. Any source edit invalidates the reviewed overlay until the source is re-reviewed and its pin is explicitly updated.
